title: English lesson: a weekday morning (intermediate learner, slips into Japanese once)

turns.text: Good morning! I slept okay, but I woke up late. I have a meeting at ten.
It's about a new app design. My team is making a to-do app for busy people.
Yes, I'm the leader. It's my first time, so I'm a little nervous.
For breakfast I had toast and coffee. I usually skip breakfast, but today I had time.
えっと、通勤は電車で40分くらいかかります。
Ah, okay. My commute takes about forty minutes by train. I usually listen to podcasts.
Mostly English podcasts about technology. Sometimes I don't understand everything, but it's fun.
How do you say 「乗り換え」 in English? I always forget this word.
Transfer, right. I transfer twice every morning. It's tiring.
After work I usually go to the gym, or I walk my dog. His name is Momo.
He's a shiba inu, three years old. He is very energetic in the morning.
Do you remember what my meeting is about today?
Yes! I hope it goes well. Anyway, I should get ready now.
Thanks for the chat. See you tomorrow!
